# BuildRecordListRequest

The filters and paging for listing builds, all optional. Filters combine with AND.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | `string[] \| null` |  | Namespace names (exact, case-sensitive), repeatable or comma-separated: `?namespace=a&namespace=b` or `?namespace=a,b`. At most 50. Ignored when listing one namespace's builds. |
| `outcome` | `string \| null` |  | Only builds that ended this way: `Succeeded`, `Failed` or `Rejected` (case-insensitive). |
| `isDeploy` | `boolean \| null` |  | True: deploys only; false: validations only. Omitted: both. |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` |  | The `nextCursor` of the previous page. |
| `limit` | `integer \| null` |  | How many builds to return: 1 to 200, default 50. |

## Example

```json
{
  "namespace": [
    "..."
  ],
  "outcome": "...",
  "isDeploy": false,
  "cursor": "...",
  "limit": 0
}
```
